text:
rachel.b: Hey all — first week! I accepted the GitHub org invite but can't see private repos (getting 404 on clone). I did SSO via Okta and set up 2FA. Any tips?

platform-it: welcome! Quick check: in Org -> People does your entry show as Member or Outside collaborator?

rachel.b: It shows up as Outside collaborator. Strange because I accepted the invite link HR sent to rachel.b@redwood.work (which forwards to rachel.personal@gmail.com while AD is pending).

mike.dev: Forwarded/work-email stuff is the usual culprit. If the invite was to the forwarding address and you accepted while logged into a different GH account, GH will attach the invite to that account as an external collaborator.

hr-ops: We used the candidate's temporary forwarding address from the offer form so that onboarding email hit rachel.personal@gmail.com. Sorry — thought we'd avoid delays.

platform-it: Ok — we'll need to remove the external collaborator entry and re-invite the canonical account. @rachel.b can you confirm the GitHub login you want associated?

rachel.b: My GH login is rachel-b (email on the account is rachel.b@personalmail.com). I want the org invite tied to rachel.b@redwood.work once AD is provisioned. Is it okay to accept now or wait?

mike.dev: Best flow: admins remove the external collaborator record, then HR/invite team re-send the org invite to rachel.b@redwood.work. When you accept, make sure you're logged into the rachel-b account in the browser. If the browser offers to switch accounts, choose the rachel-b one.

platform-it: Also verify you have SAML authorized on your GH account after acceptance: Settings -> Organizations -> click "Authorize" if prompted. If you hit 404 after acceptance, try `gh auth refresh` or clear cookies.

rachel.b: I already used a YubiKey for 2FA yesterday. Could that block SSO/autoprovision?

platform-it: Nope. Hardware 2FA is fine. The blocker here is the account mapping (external vs member).

hr-ops: Filed ticket: "invite routed to forwarding address -> external collaborator".

invite-bot: Ticket #4590 created and assigned to infra-admins. ETA: 3 business hours.

platform-it: Once infra-admins have removed the external collaborator and reissued the invite, accept it while logged into rachel-b. Then confirm you can list private repos: `gh repo list redwood-inference --private` and check team membership with `gh api orgs/redwood-inference/teams --jq '.[] | select(.name=="platform")'`.

mike.dev: If anything still looks off, ping me and I'll check team assignments.

rachel.b: Great — thanks everyone. I'll wait for the re-invite and report back. :wave:
